name: File notes take days
summary: Turns a finished Fireflies meeting summary into a draft file note that the adviser checks and files. Crons read and draft only; nothing is filed on a client record, shared or sent without a person.

all.evidence: 2 discovery calls (insurance brokerage, insurance broking) describe file notes; both write phone, email and text notes by hand

covered_by.capture-notes: partial: Fireflies records and summarises recorded meetings; phone calls, texts and emails are not captured
covered_by.draft-file-note: draft: the draft cron reads the Fireflies summary and writes a draft note
covered_by.record-keeping: not yet: the HubSpot note write is not confirmed in the vendor spec (see gaps)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New Fireflies meetings from the last few days.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Draft a file note from each new meeting's Fireflies summary, for the adviser to check. Nothing is filed or shared.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations here are reads only. The notes the crons write stay in the workflow store until an adviser files them by hand. Sharing a transcript with anyone outside the business is a live operation and waits for approval.

fireflies.covers: meeting list and summary read; transcript share and revoke are queued for approval only, and no cron uses them

gaps: HubSpot: the note body property (hs_note_body) is not declared in the mapped vendor spec (endpoint-map/raw/hubspot), and the notes create body takes free-form properties. No HubSpot adapter is built until the property name is confirmed on a live account. Drafts stay in the workflow store.
Microsoft 365 and OneNote: no OneNote operation is mapped in the kit, and Outlook mail is not read for file notes in this build. Notes from emails are not covered.
Phone calls and texts: no platform in the evidence records them automatically. A dialer integration (Aircall, CloudTalk or JustCall are mapped in the kit) would be the next source; not built.
Adviser review and sign-off: no mapped operation on any platform records an adviser sign-off. The adviser checks and files each draft by hand.
Chasing missing details, sending a client copy of a note, and filing notes into a client file: the vendor docs do not describe these steps, so they are not built.

Runtime (core, not changed here): an approved GraphQL write that returns HTTP 200 with an errors array is recorded as done, because core/sdk/call.ts and core/lib/http.ts do not read the errors array. A share that Fireflies refuses this way would show as done. Needs a core change before any live Fireflies write is approved.
Fireflies is mapped from its vendor docs and tested offline only. Nothing has run against a live account.

evidence.calls: 2 discovery calls (insurance brokerage, insurance broking) describe file notes; 2 of 2 describe the capture step as fully manual
evidence.platforms: Fireflies, HubSpot and Microsoft 365 vendor docs mapped step by step; Fireflies has the mapped operations this build uses
